job.title: Sap Commerce Cloud Consultant - €35.000 - €45.000 A Year

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with hands-on experience in Agile environments.

cover_en.subject: Application: Sap Commerce Cloud Consultant
cover_en.hook: I am very interested in the SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant position at Findmore Consulting, S.A. With over 5 years of professional backend experience specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) for enterprise clients such as Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in Java, Spring, and scalable e-commerce architectures.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & Catalog Customization
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: REST APIs & Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and investigated integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and PIM platforms to ensure reliable data flows.

bullets.label: Promotions & OMS
bullets.text: Developed and maintained core SAP Hybris modules including the Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), FlexibleSearch queries, Cronjobs, and Impex scripts.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Cloud
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows and collaborative international team environments.

cover_en.gap: While my background focuses deeply on backend SAP Commerce Cloud development, integration, and Java/Spring services rather than front-end frameworks like Angular or React, I am keen to learn and expand my capabilities in those areas.
cover_en.logistics: I am currently based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit. I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and I will be available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my experience can contribute to your team.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work for Findmore Consulting because of your established two-decade presence and reputation for delivering robust, scalable IT solutions across diverse enterprise environments. My 5+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for global enterprises aligns directly with your mission to provide adaptable, high-quality technical solutions to your clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and Java expertise to help Findmore Consulting build scalable e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I saw your SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant opening. With 5+ years of SAP Hybris experience building REST APIs, integrations, and backend modules at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I'd love to connect. I am available starting 16.12.2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant - Reference RS/SAP/C
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant position (Reference RS/SAP/C).

With over 5 years of backend and SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) experience building robust enterprise solutions, REST APIs, and integrations for clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident in my ability to add value to your team. I am serving a notice period and will be available starting 16.12.2026.

I look forward to discussing the role with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
